name: Leap Toki ni Sarawareta Shoujo
original_name: ＬＥＡＰ 時にさらわれた少女
source:
Hero has finally confessed and made love to his childhood friend Ai. But as he wakes up in unfamiliar place, he can't find Ai anywhere. He begins his search.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角終於向青梅竹馬原田愛告白，並與她發生了關係。然而，當他在一個陌生的地方醒來時，愛已不知所蹤。他就此動身去找她。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
